title: Brand New: Creepers
description: A Brand New look for the most iconic face in the game
body:
## Welcome to...
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc6dc77d315678b3abb524de67e85576601888d3.png)
# IMPORTANT!
This texture pack is **not** expected to receive new updates.

Due to my personal life and lack of motivation to keep working on texture packs, I decided to put all my projects in a uncertain hiatus. Making these packs became more of a chore than anything fun, I enjoy the process of making the textures and models, but I dislike the technical side, bugs, etc. It's just not **my** thing, I prefer doing other stuff.

If I get enough motivation and free time I might come back and update it, but for now, don't expect anything new anytime soon.

### About
> This texture pack gives the Creepers a **Brand New** look that changes depending on the biome!

*The gallery section is incomplete.*

### Requirements
> This texture pack requires [[EMF] Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) and [[ETF] Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) in order to work.

### Compatibility
> This texture pack is not compatible with Fresh Animations.
